children: Singapore construction and trading firm's H1 revenue rose 51.5% yr/yr

Gross profit margin fell to 13.9% from 21.7% due to higher direct costs
Company did not provide specific financial guidance for future periods in the press release
PROJECT PROGRESS - Co said revenue growth was mainly driven by increased progress on construction projects
MOBILE PHONE TRADING - Higher revenue contribution from mobile phone trading segment boosted overall revenue
HIGHER DIRECT COSTS - Gross profit margin declined due to increased direct costs, per management discussion
